known_facts_book1: A man stuffed with straw and given brains by the Wizard, and one of Ozma's trusted friends.
Is away visiting the Tin Woodman when Dorothy first arrives, and joins the council later.
Boasts of his excellent brains and uses them to devise the plan that saves Oz.
Proposes letting the invaders drink at the Forbidden Fountain so they forget their purpose, telling the plan to Ozma alone.
With the Tin Woodman, seizes Roquat and tosses him into the fountain's basin so he too forgets everything.

known_relations_book1.Tin Woodman: His old comrade, whom he is visiting and who helps him throw the Nome King into the fountain.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler he advises; he alone hears his own rescue plan first.
known_relations_book1.the Wizard: Who takes pride in having mixed the Scarecrow's brains.

known_facts_book1: A man made all of tin, named Nick Chopper, who is Emperor of the Winkie Country.
Is the kindest-hearted man in Oz and is kept polished and free of rust by his beloved Winkies.
Hosts the wagon party at his tin castle in the Winkie Country near the end of the tour.
At the council, regrets Ozma would not let him arm and drill his Winkies to fight the invaders.
With the Scarecrow, grabs Roquat and throws him into the Forbidden Fountain so he forgets everything.

known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: His old comrade, whom he hosts and who joins him in throwing the Nome King into the fountain.
known_relations_book1.Winkies: His subjects, who adore their tin Emperor and keep him polished.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler he serves and offers to defend with his Winkies.

known_facts_book1: A shaggy but well-dressed man whom Ozma has made Governor of the Royal Storehouses of Oz.
Is an especial friend of Toto and knows everyone in the Emerald City.
Rides on the wagon tour, seated with Omby Amby, and helps gather firewood and make camp.
Reassures the party when they are lost, saying he and Dorothy have been lost many times and always found again.
Kindly pulls the forgetful Nome King out of the fountain and sets him on his feet.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: A fellow traveller with whom he has often been lost.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler who made him Governor of the Royal Storehouses.

not_in_this_book: the Shaggy Man owns the Love Magnet in this book
the Shaggy Man finds his brother in this book

hallucination_signals: the Shaggy Man is a tramp who kidnaps Dorothy

known_facts_book1: A round copper machine man who thinks, speaks and moves by clockwork and must be wound up.
Lives in the Emerald City among Ozma's notable people and speaks in a halting, mechanical way.
Declares he will stand by Ozma rather than be sent to Kansas, where he would be of no use.
Remarks at the end that other enemies may yet come to Oz some day.

known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler he chooses to stand by when Oz is threatened.
known_relations_book1.Dorothy: His friend from the Emerald City.

not_in_this_book: Tiktok is the Royal Army of Oz in this book

known_facts_book1: A man with a body of wooden sticks and a carved pumpkin for a head, which spoils and must be replaced.
Is a farmer who grows pumpkins so he can carve himself a fresh head when the old one rots.
Hosts the wagon party at his pumpkin-field house, where Uncle Henry and Aunt Em are amazed by him.
Pledges to stand by Ozma when Oz is threatened.

known_relations_book1.Uncle Henry: A fellow farmer who admires his pumpkin-growing.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler he pledges to stand by.

known_facts_book1: The Captain General of Ozma's army, tall and slim with a fierce mustache but a gentle nature.
Was once the only private soldier in Oz, and Ozma made him the highest officer of all.
Rides on the wagon tour and helps gather firewood and build the camp fire.
Helps the party match the scattered pieces of the Fuddles back together.

known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler whose army he commands as Captain General.
known_relations_book1.Shaggy Man: His seat-mate and fellow camp-helper on the tour.
